ModMetaData.name: PUAH 1.5 Queue Hotfix V5.1
ModMetaData.author: Local hotfix
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld 1.5 queue repair hotfix for Pick Up And Haul. V5.1 keeps the V5 queue repair logic but makes successful repairs silent to avoid warning-stacktrace spam. It removes paired HaulToInventory entries with non-positive counts or invalid targets, trims unmatched queue tails, preserves valid haul entries, and keeps a final reservation-stage crash guard.
PUAH 1.5 队列修复补丁 V5.1：保留 V5 的队列自修复与防崩逻辑，但成功修复时不再输出 Warning/完整调用栈，避免在大量搬运任务下因日志刷屏造成周期性卡顿。仅在无法安全修复、必须丢弃任务时保留一次性警告。
